name: Chichigami Jinnosuke
source:
Manami's husband and the father of Kana and Rio. He is the current head of the Chichigami family.

[spoiler] He is the latest in a long line of husbands. Manami slowly drained him of his life energy in order to offer it to the father god. [/spoiler]
translation:
Manami's husband and the father of Kana and Rio. He is the current head of the Chichigami family.

[spoiler] He is the latest in a long line of husbands. Manami slowly drained him of his life energy in order to offer it to the father god. [/spoiler]
